title: (Pwn2Own) Synology BeeStation BST150-4T CRLF Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Synology BeeStation BST150-4T devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of HTTP requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied data before using it to prepare an HTTP response. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
